definitions.explanation: Warm, personal interaction or contact between people, animals, or with nature. Emphasizes the emotional and human dimension of the encounter rather than mere physical contact.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ふれあい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ふれあい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Interaction with people in the community is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{羊|ひつじ}→羊：04713_hitsuji⟧や⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ふれあうこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: At this farm, children can interact with sheep and horses.

notes:
Derived from the verb ⟦{触|ふ}れ{合|あ}う→触れ合う：10614_fureau⟧ (to touch each other, to come into contact). Written in hiragana when used as a noun referring to warm human interaction. Very common in compound names for community facilities, parks, and events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ふれあい: interaction with people
- ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ふれあい: contact with animals
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ふれあい: communing with nature
- ふれあい⟦{広場|ひろば}→広場：00104_hiroba⟧: interaction plaza (community gathering space)
- ふれあい⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧: petting zoo

USAGE:
Often appears in names of public facilities and events, giving a warm, community-oriented tone: ふれあい⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧ (community center), ふれあい⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧ (community festival).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧: exchange, interaction — more formal, often for cultural or international exchange
- ⟦{触|ふ}れ{合|あ}う→触れ合う：10614_fureau⟧: to touch each other, to interact — the verb form
- ⟦コミュニケーション→コミュニケーション：08425_komyunikeeshon⟧: communication — borrowed English word, broader in scope
